diagnostics.message: Telo.Definition 'Greeter': 'Telo.Invokable' is not a capability. Did you mean 'Telo.Invocable'? A capability names a lifecycle role — one of: Telo.Callable, Telo.Invocable, Telo.Mount, Telo.Provider, Telo.Runnable, Telo.Service, Telo.Sink, Telo.Type.

`description: v ${{ 1 }}` is now written `description: !interpolate v ${{ 1 }}`.
A plain string is never an expression. A value that is one `${{ }}` hole is written `!cel`, and text with values embedded in it is written `!interpolate`, whose holes convert through CEL's own `string()` and whose result is checked against the field it fills. Read this way, a hole that is null, a list or a map at runtime fails with ERR_INTERPOLATION_HOLE_NOT_CONVERTIBLE where the untagged spelling printed empty text or a comma list: guard such a hole, or convert it inside the hole.
